column1: By- Law regarding Mobile Trading within Authoritative Area
THIS  is  to  notify  that  I,  Dhamma  Dissanayake,  Governor  of  the  Sabaragamuwa  Province  has  approved  the  By-law
regarding  Mobile  Trading  within  authoritative  area  of  Rambukkana  Pradeshiya  Sabha,  prepared  by  the  Rambukkana
Pradeshiya Sabha by virtue of powers vested in it under Section 122 read with Section 126 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No.
15  of  1987  and passed at  its  General meeting held  on 25.06.2019, by  virtue  of  powers  vested  under  Section  123(1)  of
Pradeshiya Sabha Act read with Section 2 of Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989, and it
will be effective within authoritative area of Rambukkana Pradeshiya Sabha from the date this notification is published
